title: Chapelier - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Chapelier in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The base form of the Sorrowful Chapelier mask in Visages. It appears on its own near The Crows.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toFire, Dark
ResistsIce
AbsorbsNone
ImmuneNone

Bring Fire, Dark damage. Ice is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: How to Beat the Chapelier
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Fire, Dark is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It resists Ice, so that damage is halved.
